description: Evaluate explicit pass/fail/skipped counts from a consolidated test summary. Empty or incomplete reports do not pass by default. This returns a gate decision for CI/coding agents; it does not mutate CI settings or launch tests.

maxAgeMinutes.description: Maximum age of the consolidated report. Reports older than this are blocked; default 24 hours.

reportPath.description: Path to a consolidated summary.json, relative to project root or absolute inside it. Defaults to the newest summary.

requireCurrentHead.description: Require complete source-report Git SHA provenance matching the current project HEAD; default true.

name: evaluate_test_gate
title: Evaluate a Test Report CI Gate
